subject: This Week's Lessons: Initial Lesson + Lunar Rover
body:
We hit the ground running with two big milestones: an **Initial Lesson** to learn our class routines and a creative **Lunar Rover** build 🚀🌕. Students learned where to find parts, how to share tools, and how to debug like engineers. Then they designed rovers to creep over “craters,” testing traction, torque, and careful turns. There were cheers, high-fives, and lots of “aha!” moments as bots conquered their first obstacles!

**Level 1** focused on core build skills and simple motor control (start/stop, timed moves) 😊. **Level 2** added sensors and tuning (distance/line/light), experimenting with sequencing and speed profiles 🔧. **Level 3** pushed into strategy and robustness—closed-loop control, obstacle logic, and quick debugging under test-conditions 🧠.

Next week, we’ll take everything we learned and build on it with **Drones**. Thank you for cheering the students on—they’re growing fast as builders, coders, and teammates! 🙏 As always, please reach out with any questions. 

🔗 Join us on Seesaw 📱
